card.name: Vaccine words in immunosuppressant warnings
card.fires_on: The word vaccine, vaccines, vaccination or immunization (including its inner pieces) in drug-label warnings about immune suppression. It also fires on 'to' just before immunizations.

modes.description: Vaccines named after words like live, inactivated, non-live or all, in warnings that the drug may blunt vaccine response.
